title: Redux Store
overview: The Redux Store is a centralized place where the complete application state is stored and managed.

title: Actions
overview: Actions are plain JavaScript objects that describe what change should happen in the application state.

title: Reducers
overview: Reducers are pure functions that receive the current state and an action, then return a new updated state.

title: Dispatch
overview: Dispatch is used to send actions to the Redux store to trigger state updates.

title: State Management Flow
overview: Redux follows a predictable flow where actions are dispatched, reducers process changes, and the store updates the state.

example.title: Complete Flow
example.content:
Component
 ↓
Dispatch
 ↓
Action
 ↓
Reducer
 ↓
Store
 ↓
Component Update

title: Immutable State
overview: Redux requires state updates without directly modifying the existing state object. A new state object should be returned.

example.title: Immutable Update
example.content:
Wrong:
state.count++

Correct:
return {...state, count: state.count + 1}

title: Topic Summary
overview: You learned the main Redux concepts including store, actions, reducers, dispatch, state flow, and immutable updates.
